howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: From sign-up to your first gig in minutes.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Choose your role — musician or venue. 7-day trial, no credit card required.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Add genres, instruments, venue atmosphere and set your location in one click.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Claude AI analyses style, budget and atmosphere compatibility. You only see matches ≥ 50%.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Approve a proposal — a real-time chat opens. Agree on details and play.
howItWorks.featuresSubtitle: One product instead of spreadsheets, phone calls and classifieds.
howItWorks.feat1Desc: Musicians and gigs visible on Google Maps in your area with the AI score on the pin.
howItWorks.feat2Desc: Claude AI rates style, budget and atmosphere compatibility. Severe mismatches are excluded.
howItWorks.feat3Desc: Each approved proposal opens a direct chat. Parallel conversations with multiple parties.
howItWorks.feat4Desc: 7 days free. Musician: €1.99/mo. Venue: €3.99/mo. Cancel anytime.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy sets out the rules for storing and accessing data on the devices of users of the GigMatch service (a platform connecting musicians with venues) for the purpose of providing electronic services by the Administrator, as well as the rules for collecting and processing personal data of Users provided voluntarily through tools available in the Service.
privacy.s1_serviceDesc: – the GigMatch website operated by the Administrator, serving as a platform connecting musicians with venues (clubs, bars, restaurants, hotels), where venues can publish performance offers (gigs) and musicians can respond to them.
privacy.s1_adminDesc: – Paweł Eberle, conducting unregistered business activity under the name Paveelo, address: ul. Zamojskiego 18H/2, 37-450 Stalowa Wola, e-mail: eberlepawel@gmail.com.
privacy.s1_userDesc: – a natural person using the Service, in particular: a musician (artist seeking performances) and a venue (entity offering performances).
privacy.s1_deviceDesc: – an electronic device with software through which the User accesses the Service.
privacy.s1_cookiesDesc: – text data collected in the form of files placed on the User's Device.
privacy.s1_personalDataDesc: – information about an identified or identifiable natural person.
privacy.s1_locationDataDesc: – information about the geographic location of the User, shared voluntarily via the browser upon explicit consent (applies to the 'I'm available' feature for musicians).
privacy.s2Text: Under Art. 37 GDPR, the Administrator has not appointed a Data Protection Officer. Contact regarding data protection:
privacy.s3_internalDesc: – stored and read by the Service system (e.g. login mechanisms, session maintenance, account settings).
privacy.s3_externalDesc: – stored and read by external service systems (e.g. Google, payment systems).
privacy.s3_sessionDesc: – deleted when the browser session ends.
privacy.s3_persistentDesc: – stored until manually deleted or expired.
privacy.s4_p1: Cookie read/write mechanisms operate through the web browser and do not allow retrieval of other data from the User's Device. The Administrator applies technical and organisational measures adequate to the risk (Art. 32 GDPR), including SSL/TLS encryption, access control and backups.
privacy.s4_p2: The User may at any time change cookie settings in the browser or delete stored cookies. Restricting the use of cookies may affect the functioning of some Service features.
privacy.s5_intro: Data voluntarily provided by the User is processed in particular for the following purposes:
privacy.s5_l1: creation and operation of User accounts (musician, venue), platform operation (publishing performance offers, matching musicians, communication) – Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR;
privacy.s5_l2: subscription and payment processing (Musician plan: $1.99/mo, Venue plan: $3.99/mo, 7-day trial) – Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR;
privacy.s5_l3: processing of location data for the purpose of matching musicians with nearby venues – Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR (only on the basis of explicit consent);
privacy.s5_l4: contact and enquiry handling – Art. 6(1)(b) or (f) GDPR;
privacy.s5_l5: fulfilment of legal obligations – Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR.
privacy.s6_p1: GigMatch uses location data solely to match musicians with nearby venues. Location is shared only when the musician activates the 'I'm available' feature and is never shared when this feature is disabled.
privacy.s6_p2: Consent to share location is voluntary and may be withdrawn at any time by disabling the 'I'm available' feature or changing browser settings.
privacy.s6_p3: Location data is not stored for longer than necessary to fulfil the purpose (matching with venues).
privacy.s7_autoDesc: IP address, browser type, operating system, visit time, cookie/device identifiers.
privacy.s7_voluntaryDesc: name, e-mail, password (hashed), role (musician/venue), bio, profile photo, music genre, instruments, audio/video samples (links), availability calendar, location data (optional), billing data.
privacy.s8Title: §8 Access to Data by Third Parties
privacy.s8_intro: Data may be shared with entities providing services necessary for the operation of the Service:
privacy.s8_l1: hosting and infrastructure providers (e.g. Supabase, Vercel);
privacy.s9_l1: data processed on the basis of consent – until consent is withdrawn;
privacy.s9_l2: data processed on the basis of legitimate interest – until an effective objection is raised;
privacy.s9_l3: accounting/tax data – for the period required by law;
privacy.s9_l4: location data – only during an active 'I'm available' session.
privacy.s10_intro: Users have rights arising from the GDPR:
privacy.s10_l1: right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, and data portability;
privacy.s10_l3: right to withdraw consent at any time;
privacy.s10_l4: right to lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority.
privacy.s10_contactText: Requests may be submitted by e-mail:
privacy.s10_contactSuffix: or by post to: ul. Zamojskiego 18H/2, 37-450 Stalowa Wola.
privacy.s11Text: The Administrator may update this Privacy Policy. Users will be informed of significant changes through publication of an updated version in the Service. Continued use of the Service after changes are published constitutes acceptance of the new Privacy Policy.
